name: Workshop Entrance
summary: Beyond the Train Depot, Workshop Entrance gives a backdoor into Gnomeregan. The route opens near the Engineering Labs and bypasses the front gates, offering another way into the irradiated city.

sections.title: The Backdoor to the City
sections.body: Past the Train Depot, Workshop Entrance crosses the cavernous workshop floor toward the industrial heart of Gnomeregan. The opening to the Loading Room lies on one side. This passage runs straight to the Engineering Labs, avoiding the fortified entry gates near the surface, where leper gnomes and troggs contest the way. For those trying to reclaim the underground capital, this side door bypasses the first perimeter.

faq.q: Where is the Workshop Entrance located?
faq.answer: Workshop Entrance lies across the workshop floor, past the Train Depot in Gnomeregan’s outer corridors. The portal to the Loading Room is to your left.

faq.q: Why is this area called the backdoor?
faq.answer: The name comes from its use as an alternate way into Gnomeregan’s interior, skipping the main front gauntlet and leading toward the Engineering Labs.

faq.q: Where does this doorway lead inside the city?
faq.answer: The doorway opens onto a hallway that leads directly to the Engineering Labs, deep inside Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As a gnome, you know every secret doorway into Gnomeregan could help reclaim lost workshops and recover prototype machinery from Mekgineer Thermaplugg’s forces.
As an engineer, you can take this corridor toward the Engineering Labs, where cutting-edge schematics may draw tinkerers to infiltrate.
